name: trueline-lint
description: Deterministic architectural and code-hygiene linter for TypeScript and monorepos: deep modules, narrow interfaces, clean architecture, zero slop.
author: Jordan Hall

scripts.build: bun build src/cli/bin.ts src/index.ts --outdir dist --root src --target node --format esm --external typescript && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/fix-dts.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run check-types && bun test
scripts.verify: bun run check-types && bun run build && bun test && bun src/cli/bin.ts && node dist/cli/bin.js
